title: Disappearing Species
summary: This WWF poster addresses the impact of climate change on koalas, an endangered species threatened by habitat destruction and rising temperatures.

overview.challenge: Inspired by a WWF awareness brief, the poster needed to communicate the threat of habitat destruction and environmental change without relying on a literal or sensational image.
overview.solution: The design creates a symbolic visual representation merging the koala with the cause of their decline.
overview.outcome: The final image uses negative space as a metaphor for loss, connecting the koala’s disappearance to the industrial forces contributing to its decline.

blocks.label: 01 — Research
blocks.heading: Researching loss and habitat pressure
blocks.body: Research focused on endangered species, habitat loss, pollution, and the visual language of environmental awareness campaigns. I looked for a way to connect the animal to the cause of its decline through one memorable image rather than a crowded list of facts.

blocks.label: 02 — Sketches
blocks.heading: Building the image through negative space
blocks.body: Early studies tested figure-ground relationships and how much detail the silhouette could hold. The final direction places industrial forms inside the koala shape, letting the animal and its environment read as one image.

blocks.label: 03 — Final
blocks.caption: A koala silhouette filled with the industrial forms contributing to habitat loss.
